question: Should maintainers continue repairing this narrower PR, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97145 the canonical fix for the approval-copy regression?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not product strategy, but overlapping open PRs and proof-positive sibling work make canonical branch selection a maintainer coordination choice.

options.title: Use the broader sibling candidate
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97145 the canonical path if maintainers accept its ask-threading approach and close or supersede narrower overlapping PRs after it lands.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Ask this PR to thread `ask` through Telegram native, Telegram forwarding, and embedded reconstructed prompts, add focused tests, and refresh current-head real behavior proof.

options.title: Choose a typed reason contract
options.body: If maintainers prefer producer-owned unavailable reasons over ask inference, use the typed-reason approach from a sibling PR and update the protocol/UI surfaces intentionally.

recommendation.title: Use the broader sibling candidate
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97145 the canonical path if maintainers accept its ask-threading approach and close or supersede narrower overlapping PRs after it lands.
